login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Use the email address and password of your {product} account.
setup.title: Set up Kalzit
setup.lead: Create the first organization and your account as its owner.
setup.tokenHint: The server writes it to the file “setup-token.txt” in its data folder on first start, unless a fixed setup code is configured.
setup.orgNameHint: You can add more organizations later.
setup.name: Your name
login.rateLimited: Too many failed sign-ins. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
password.strengthFair: Good length. A mix of upper and lower case, digits and symbols makes it stronger.
password.strengthStrong: Good length and a mix of characters.
auth.tagline: Your data, in the shape it already has.
auth.pitch: Self-hosted and open source, for dashboards and analysis. Tables stay tables, documents stay documents, graphs stay graphs.
auth.illustration: Drawing of the three result shapes: a time series as a frame, a document tree and a graph.
validation.orgNameRequired: Enter a name for the organization.
validation.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
validation.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least {count} characters.
validation.passwordTooLong: The password can have at most {count} characters.
validation.controlCharacters: Remove line breaks and other control characters.
validation.serverRejected: The server did not accept this value. Check it and try again.
errors.validation: The server did not accept the input. Check the fields and try again.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
errors.invalid_credentials: Email address or password is incorrect.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.busy: The server is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.cross_origin: The server rejected the request because this address does not match its configuration. If the server runs behind a reverse proxy, set server.public_url or security.trusted_proxies in its configuration.
errors.setup_done: Kalzit is already set up. Sign in with your account.
errors.invalid_setup_token: The setup code is not correct. Copy it again from “setup-token.txt”.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Try again; if it keeps happening, check the server log.
errors.method_not_allowed: The server does not accept this kind of request here. Check that the versions of the UI and the server match.
errors.payload_too_large: That is too much data for one request. Make it smaller and try again.
errors.conflict: This clashes with something that already exists, for example a name in use. Change it and try again.
errors.version_conflict: Someone else saved a newer version in the meantime. Reload to see it, then make your change again.
errors.datasource_error: The data source reported an error. Check its connection settings and the query, then try again.
errors.datasource_target_blocked: The server does not allow connections to this address. Ask a server admin to allow it, or use another address.
errors.query_timeout: The query took too long and was stopped. Narrow it down, for example with a shorter time range, and try again.
errors.query_rejected: The query was rejected because it could change data. Data sources are read-only; use a query that only reads.
errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check that it is running, then try again.
errors.invalid_response: The server sent an unexpected response. Check that the versions of the UI and the server match.
